Hinweise betreffen nur dein eigenes Kont: Notifications concern your own account only: passwords, sign-in factors, passkeys, sessions and newly authorised devices. Other household members are not notified.
Ein Gerätehinweis ist höchstens eine Stu: A device notification stays current for at most one hour. Both account and device must have opted in before the event; later permission does not replay past events.
Die persönliche Meldung bleibt in deinem: The personal message stays in your inbox even when a security change ends all sessions. Names, passwords and device details never appear on the lock screen.
Die Berechtigungen oder der Status deine: Your account permissions or status were changed.
Ein Gerät wurde für Benachrichtigungen f: A device was authorised for notifications.
